value.reason: The Evidence is one line from monitoring/grafana-dashboard.json: a panel titled "Solved $difficulties Star Challenges". That panel tracks challenges solved, not who accesses personal data. The data flow shows Profile data being stored (AddressModel.create with UserId, fullName, mobileNum, streetAddress and similar fields), so Rule 6(1)(c) does apply: it requires logs and monitoring that can detect unauthorised access to personal data. A MON-01 finding needs proof that the dashboard as a whole has no panels or metrics on access to that data, such as access or authentication failures, or reads and changes to address and profile records. One panel title cannot show that. The rest of the dashboard, its panel targets and metric expressions, and any other monitoring or logging setup are not in the Evidence. In the context examples, the deciding factor was whether an access-related panel (like 'Login failures') existed. Here we cannot tell whether such panels exist, so the Evidence is not enough to call this a true or false positive.
